reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000459 (the melody read from 000459a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. CCEH's page spells Will S. Hays as “William S. Hayes”; the name is printed as the sources spell it. Will S. Hays's dates (1837–1907) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Hays_WS (Hays, Will S. (William Shakespeare), 1837-1907; SALVATIONIST, 1871; CCEH spells him Hayes); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Will_S._Hays agrees; CCEH's page gives only the year 1871. Charles W. Fry's dates (1838–1882) are from our page for The Lily of the Valley (content/hymns/the-lily-of-the-valley.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1881. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000459a.nwc).
